entities.summary: The Guaramid dynasty or Guaramiani was the younger branch of the Chosroid royal house of Iberia. They ruled Iberia as Grand dukes (erismtavari) in the periods of 588–627, 684–748, and 779/780–786, and three of them were bestowed with the dignity of curopalates by the Byzantine imperial court.
